svg.title: A one-step stale command can make a loop unstable
svg.desc: Two recurrences of the teaching model x(k+1) = x(k) + u(k+1). With u(k+1) = -1.5 x(k) the error halves and changes sign at every step. With the stale command u(k+1) = -1.5 x(k-1) the error oscillates and grows by the factor square root of 1.5 per step.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: A FAST MESSAGE WITH THE WRONG PREDECESSOR
roots of λ² − λ + 1.5 = 0 have |λ| = √1.5 ≈ 1.225; dashed: ±2(√1.5)k
